# MethodCache

> Cache any .NET method with one attribute. A .NET library (net8.0, net9.0, net10.0): a source generator turns `[Cache]` on interface methods into caching decorators at compile time, with keys built from the arguments, tag invalidation, a memory cache plus optional Redis or SQL Server, and policies you can change in appsettings.json or at runtime.

Put `[Cache]` and `[CacheInvalidate]` on interface methods (not classes), register services, then call `builder.Services.AddMethodCache()` after them. Every C# example in these docs is compiled in CI. For coding agents, [docs/ai/methodcache.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/ai/methodcache.md) is a compact rule set and [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/llms-full.txt) has all the docs in one file.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/getting-started.md): put `[Cache]` on an interface method and register it.
- [Generated decorators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/source-generator.md): supported signatures and forwarded interface members.
- [Cache keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/keys.md): how keys are built from the arguments, and how to control them.
- [Expiration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/expiration.md): duration, sliding expiration, refresh-ahead and versions.
- [Invalidation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/invalidation.md): tags with argument templates, keys and patterns.
- [Fail-safe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/fail-safe.md): serve the last good value when a dependency fails or is slow.
- [Conditional caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/conditional-caching.md): store only the results you want to keep.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/configuration.md): defaults, groups, `appsettings.json` with live reload, runtime overrides.
- [Manual caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/manual-caching.md): `GetOrCreateAsync` with a key you choose.
- [Caching third-party code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/third-party.md): cache a client from a NuGet package.
- [HTTP response caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/http-caching.md): `HttpClient` caching with `Cache-Control` and `ETag`.
- [Distributed cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/distributed-cache.md): Redis, SQL Server, or your own `IDistributedCache` with atomic invalidation stamps.
- [Monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/monitoring.md): statistics, admin endpoints, health check and OpenTelemetry.
- [Memory cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/memory-cache.md): size limits, null values and jitter.
- [Native AOT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/native-aot.md): what to register when you publish with Native AOT.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/testing.md): test with caching on, or turn it off.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/security.md): what each package protects against, and what it leaves to you.
- [MethodCache: instructions for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/ai/methodcache.md): rules to copy into Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code instructions.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): a method that isn't cached, stale data, keys you didn't expect.
- [Build diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/user-guide/DIAGNOSTICS.md): every `MC` and `MCG` warning and error.
- [Migrating from IMemoryCache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/migration-from-imemorycache.md): replace hand-written cache-aside code.
- [MethodCache.Redis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.Redis/README.md): Redis as MethodCache's distributed cache.
- [MethodCache.SqlServer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.SqlServer/README.md): SQL Server as MethodCache's distributed cache.
- [MethodCache.AspNetCore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.AspNetCore/README.md): Admin endpoints and a health check for MethodCache's in-memory cache.
- [MethodCache.OpenTelemetry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.OpenTelemetry/README.md): OpenTelemetry metrics and traces for MethodCache.
- [MethodCache.HttpCaching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.HttpCaching/README.md): HTTP caching for `HttpClient`, the way a browser does it: responses are cached according to `Cache-Control`, revalidated with `ETag` / `Last-Modified`, and a `304 Not Modified` comes back to your code as the full cached response.
- [MethodCache.Serialization.MessagePack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.Serialization.MessagePack/README.md): Stores MethodCache's distributed cache values (Redis, SQL Server or a custom distributed cache) as compact MessagePack instead of the default System.Text.Json: smaller entries and faster reads.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/CHANGELOG.md): Changes that a user of the packages notices.
